Stephon Marbury

Pronunciation: \steff-ON MAR-berry\

Stephon Xavier Marbury

(Starbury, Coney Island’s Finest, Steph)

Position: Point Guard ▪ Shoots: Right

6-2, 180lb (188cm, 81kg)

Born: February 20, 1977 in Brooklyn, New York us

Relatives: Cousins Sebastian Telfair, Jamel Thomas

College: Georgia Tech

High School: Abraham Lincoln in Brooklyn, New York

Draft: Milwaukee Bucks, 1st round (4th pick, 4th overall), 1996 NBA Draft

NBA Debut: November 1, 1996

Career Length: 13 years
